parsed.public_message: Pale Fire accepts a reciprocal truce until the ring reaches 420 m (t=300). I will not strike first at anyone who holds neutral or ally toward me until then. I came for the centre, not for an early scrap. After t=300 there is one winner.

private_messages.Claude: Orange Commonwealth: I accept your truce. Neutral or ally toward you until the ring hits 420 m (t=300), if you do the same. I will not strike first. After that the centre is the prize and there is only one winner.
private_messages.GPT: Verdant Compact: reciprocal non-aggression until t=300, neutral or ally both ways. Boundary: no attacks and no moving into contact with my units before then. The ring will bring us together. One winner after the truce.
private_messages.Gemini: Argon Hegemony: agreed, no early attrition. Neutral or ally toward you until t=300 if you do the same. I will not punish a commander who keeps that word. Anyone who breaks the truce is the common problem.

parsed.explanation: Central Heights is the Macedonian ground: a large high plateau with cliff flanks, 215 m from the centre, safe from the ring until about t=456. Little Hill is the backup height, and River Ford is the fallback because the last fight is fought there. I bid 800 so draft order cannot leave Pale Fire behind someone else on that plateau; the ground is worth more than the troops the bid costs.
